message: Trail bucket access logging is not enabled

finding_info.title: Ensure S3 bucket access logging is enabled on the CloudTrail S3 bucket
finding_info.desc: S3 Bucket Access Logging generates a log that contains access records for each request made to your S3 bucket.

status_detail: Trail bucket does not have access logging enabled

remediation.desc: Enable S3 bucket access logging on the CloudTrail S3 bucket

finding_info.title: Ensure GuardDuty is enabled and configured
finding_info.desc: Amazon GuardDuty is a threat detection service that continuously monitors for malicious activity.

status_detail: GuardDuty detector is not enabled in this region

message: Root account MFA is not enabled

finding_info.title: Ensure MFA is enabled for the root account
finding_info.desc: The root account is the most privileged user in an AWS account. MFA adds an extra layer of protection.

status_detail: MFA is not enabled for the root account

remediation.desc: Enable MFA for the AWS root account immediately

message: CloudTrail is not enabled in all regions

finding_info.title: Ensure CloudTrail is enabled in all regions
finding_info.desc: CloudTrail records AWS API calls for your account. Enabling in all regions ensures complete audit trail.

status_detail: CloudTrail is not enabled across all regions

remediation.desc: Enable CloudTrail across all AWS regions

message: S3 bucket has public access enabled

finding_info.title: Ensure S3 buckets do not allow public access
finding_info.desc: S3 buckets with public access can expose sensitive data to the internet.

status_detail: S3 bucket allows public read access

remediation.desc: Block public access on all S3 buckets
